facts.text: The hotel is in Coconut Grove, Miami, with views of Biscayne Bay and the Coconut Grove skyline.
facts.excerpt: An oasis within bustling South Florida surrounded by breathtaking views of **Biscayne Bay** and the **Coconut Grove Skyline**

facts.text: The rooftop pool is reserved for hotel guests and has cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Reserved for hotel guests, this serene outdoor retreat features elegant cabanas, thoughtful amenities, and a refined atmosphere designed for leisure at every pace.

facts.text: The rooftop pool has views of Biscayne Bay, Coconut Grove, Brickell and South Beach.
facts.excerpt: the pool invites guests to unwind while taking in panoramic views of Biscayne Bay, Coconut Grove, Brickell, and South Beach.

facts.text: Guests get private beach access on Miami Beach in partnership with Boucher Brothers, with two reserved chairs and towels.
facts.excerpt: In partnership with Boucher Brothers, guests are welcomed to a private beach setting complete with two reserved chairs and towels.

facts.text: Additional beach amenities and watersports are available on request at the beach.
facts.excerpt: Settle in for a leisurely day by the ocean, with additional beach amenities and watersports available upon request.

facts.text: BeAtala Wellness Spa offers personalized treatments, innovative therapies and holistic practices.
facts.excerpt: BeAtala Wellness Spa offers a thoughtful blend of personalized treatments, innovative therapies, and holistic practices tailored to each guest's individual needs.

facts.text: The hotel has a fully equipped fitness center.
facts.excerpt: our fully equipped fitness center provides a modern space to energize and recharge

facts.text: Bellini is the rooftop restaurant, serving classic Italian cuisine with views of Biscayne Bay.
facts.excerpt: From the rooftop elegance of Bellini, where classic Italian cuisine and contemporary creations are paired with sweeping views of Biscayne Bay

facts.text: Il Giardino offers relaxed breakfasts, lunches and cocktails in a garden-inspired setting.
facts.excerpt: the garden-inspired charm of Il Giardino, offering relaxed breakfasts, leisurely lunches and cocktails amid lush surroundings

facts.text: The hotel is run by the Cipriani family, with brothers Ignazio and Maggio Cipriani leading it.
facts.excerpt: is headed by the famed Cipriani family with brothers Ignazio and Maggio Cipriani spearheading this hospitality venture

facts.text: Arquitectonica designed the building, inspired by the Stiltsville structures and nautical elements from Venice.
facts.excerpt: Local architecture firm Arquitectonica designed the building taking inspiration from the the pier-like Stiltsville structures

facts.text: The facade has porthole windows and sail-like tarps separating each balcony, a nod to Coconut Grove's sailboat culture.
facts.excerpt: The boutique hotel’s facade is made up of porthole windows and sail-like tarps separate each balcony, a nod to Coconut Grove’s sailboat culture

facts.text: Every room has a private balcony, some with bay views.
facts.excerpt: Each of the hotel’s 100 rooms features a private balcony, some with views of the bay (the higher the floor, the better the view).

facts.text: Rooms were designed by Martin Brudnizki, with walnut furniture, blue-tiled walk-in showers and toiletries custom-made in Italy.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Martin Brudnizki, the rooms have a polished flair with glossy walnut wood furniture, bright blue-tiled walk-in showers and toiletries custom-made in Italy for the hotel brand.

facts.text: All guests get a complimentary Bellini at check-in.
facts.excerpt: all guests are treated to a complimentary bellini at check-in

facts.text: The hotel is down the street from the CocoWalk outdoor mall.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is located down the street from the Cocowalk outdoor mall

facts.text: The hotel is not on or near a beach; South Beach is a short drive away.
facts.excerpt: While the hotel is not located on or near a beach, the white sand beaches of South Beach are a short drive away

facts.text: Families can use suites with pull-out couches or adjoining rooms.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is a better fit for couples and single travelers but families will be fine with suites with pull-out couches or adjoining rooms.

facts.text: The lobby has nautical, vintage-inspired details such as velvet seating and a lacquered wood desk.
facts.excerpt: The intimate lobby is outfitted with nautical, vintage-inspired details from the plush velvet seating to a lacquered wood desk like you'd find on a sailboat.

facts.text: The hotel opened in 2020.
facts.excerpt: The hotel opened in 2020

facts.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor event venues overlooking Biscayne Bay.
facts.excerpt: our versatile indoor and outdoor venues combine exceptional service, thoughtfully curated cuisine, and stunning waterfront surroundings
